messages:
Alyssa Park: Quick internal roll call for Cedar Health onboarding. Short checklist: stakeholders, who presents enablement, 30-day targets, and renewal watch. Dry run tomorrow 9:15am PT?
Marco Rivera: 9:15 works. I'll cover the API integration and retry/timeout recommendations. Also confirm whether they want streaming vs request/response.
Zoe Tan: I'll own success metrics and the healthboard. Proposed 30-day KPIs: 1) authenticated test calls from staging, 2) 5 validated prompts hitting quality gate, 3) health dashboard publishing alerts, 4) pilot >= 200 calls/day.
Ethan Cole: SE here  I'll do embeddings mapping and cost estimate; flag: if they batch >800 vects/min we should propose a short Dedicated trial.
Alyssa Park: Customer contacts: Rajesh (PM), Priya (Data), Marcus (Security). Internal: Alyssa (CS Lead), Marco (Infra/SE), Zoe (CS Ops), Ethan (Solutions).
Marco Rivera: Timeline suggestion: Day 0: creds + test org; Day 1-4: integration + schema mapping; Day 5-11: validation & perf; Day 12-25: pilot; Day 26-30: handoff + retro. Add security pre-check on Day 1 if VPC requested.
Zoe Tan: Success criteria (short bullets): - End-to-end demo in staging; - 5 prompts passing quality threshold; - Dashboard with alerting; - Customer acceptance email.
Ethan Cole: Quick dev snippet I'll include in the enablement deck:
```python
# minimal call example
import requests
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', json={"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"Extract diagnoses"})
print(resp.status_code)
```
Alyssa Park: Renewal risk rules: mark "At-risk" if no pilot traffic by day 30 OR if security blocks data path. Zoe please add a "renewal_flag" column to the board and pre-populate mitigation steps.
Zoe Tan: Will do. Also planning a 3-question post-demo survey to capture NPS-ish feedback and integration blockers.
Marco Rivera: Capacity note: embeddings throughput and concurrent chats are the likely bottlenecks. If they expect spikes >1000 rps we route to dedicated or suggest aggressive throttling. I'll draft a perf checklist.
scheduler-bot: Created event "Cedar Health  Internal Dry Run" on 2026-06-03 09:15 PT. Guests: Alyssa Park, Marco Rivera, Zoe Tan, Ethan Cole.
Alyssa Park: Action items: Marco - perf checklist + infra notes; Zoe - healthboard + survey; Ethan - embeddings cost + sample prompts; me - customer invite & agenda. Please add 5 sample prompts to the shared doc before the dry run (link in #cs-resources).
Ethan Cole: I'll upload prompt examples and rough cost calc to the shared folder by EOD.
Zoe Tan: I'll post the draft healthboard in #cs-tools and tag the group for review.
Alyssa Park: If there are no objections I'll invite Rajesh and Priya after our dry run. :thumbsup:
Marco Rivera: :thumbsup:
Ethan Cole: See you all tomorrow.
Alyssa Park: Closing internal thread for now, will follow up with the customer-facing invite and the rehearsal notes.
